missing.notes: Opened 1998, Martabe Sejahtera is a public-access 18-hole par-72 championship course in Namorambe, Deli Serdang, ~22 km south of central Medan on the Berastagi road. One of four major 18-hole layouts in Greater Medan (alongside Royal Sumatra, Tamora and Graha Metropolitan/Helvetia).

notes: Outer-island 81-course inventory is largely complete. Martabe Sejahtera (Medan/Deli Serdang) is the one missing major operating 18-hole. Bali, Lombok, Bintan, Batam, Sulawesi, Kalimantan, Maluku, Papua all confirmed complete versus GolfLux/GolfPass/Hole19/APLGI directories.
